tool: sema_embed_on_ingest A/B (ingest-side isolation) — consumer audit + dogfood bed parity
question: should [ingestion] sema_embed_on_ingest default flip to false? (dense half already flipped in open PR #392)
verdict: ESCALATE — dogfood scale cannot resolve the one live consumer's delta. Arm B loses 2/18 delivered needles (deterministic, replicated in both run orders), but the equivalent serve-world isolation at 100k/n=30 (sema_ab_100k_run1.json) measured ZERO delivered delta; pooled evidence is -2/48 (~-4pp), inside noise. Deciding cell named below.

verdict_detail.why_not_FLIP: not parity: delivered_gold_rate 0.7222 -> 0.6111 (-2 needles), pool r@12 0.8889 -> 0.8333 (-1 needle). Both effects are the Tier 4 sema_boost tier's removal (#227 global-off), deterministic and exactly replicated across two grade runs per arm.
verdict_detail.why_not_KEEP: final-order r@12 is IDENTICAL (0.8889 both arms), packet delivered is IDENTICAL (0.8333), and the prior read-gate isolation on the 100k erb bed (n=30) measured delivered 15/30 = 15/30 with the same serve world (knob false = codec never materializes = stored vectors unread, so the read-gate arm is A/B-equivalent for every retrieval-path consumer). One of the two dogfood losses is an [abstain] floor-calibration coupling, not lost retrieval (gold still at final rank 8; assembly withheld everything with abstain_reason=score_below_floor — the floor was calibrated with sema_boost's ~2.0-weighted score mass present). n=18: one needle = 5.6pp; a 2-needle delta on one bed contradicted by a 0-delta on another bed is not a KEEP receipt.
verdict_detail.deciding_cell: no_sema read-gate arm on the 829k blob at n=469, delivered basis — the postflip_default_confirm_829k.json convention (bed f:/tmp/erb_blob.db + ablation_ladder.py no_sema arm + 469-needle set; NOT touched by this run per ERB-bed freeze). Because #227 knob-false removes the codec, the read-gate arm equals the ingest-side arm on the whole retrieval path; the only ingest-side residuals (bed shape, TCM/PLR/CWoLa side-features) all measured parity or designed-fallback-clean here. If n=469 delivered delta is null-to-hair like PKI (#370), flip WITH an [abstain] floor recalibration note; if it reproduces at -5pp+, keep.
verdict_detail.if_flipped_anyway: pair the flip with an [abstain] recalibration pass — score_below_floor was tuned against a score distribution that included sema_boost mass on every query.

caveats: n=18 needles: one needle = 5.6pp. The -2 delivered needles are deterministic on THIS bed but the same serve-world isolation on the 100k erb bed (n=30) measured 0 delta — the effect is bed/corpus-dependent and the pooled evidence (-2/48) is inside the noise band.
Build wall times are chunked (2 subprocess chunks per arm, model load re-paid per chunk) — throughput rider only; the calibrated ingest-cost receipt is PR #379's run_ingest_throughput.py.
